question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Widespread occurrence of an infectious disease crossing international boundaries.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Pandemic'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** group of words** *"Widespread occurrence of an infectious disease crossing international boundaries"* **refers** to a disease that is prevalent over a whole country or the world.
 
• The **most appropriate one-word **substitute from the given options is: Pandemic -
 
• **This term refers to** a disease prevalent over a whole country or the world, typically affecting a large number of people.(महामारी)
 
• The term has been widely used during the COVID-19 crisis.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is:** 'Pandemic'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **Sporadic -** This term means occurring at irregular intervals or only in a few places; scattered or isolated. (छिटपुट).
 
• **Epidemic -** An epidemic is a widespread occurrence of an infectious disease in a community or specific geographic area at a particular time. While similar to a pandemic, an epidemic doesn't necessarily cross international boundaries.(महामारी), same as pandemic, but often used in a more localized context.
 
• **Catastrophic -** This term refers to an event causing great and usually sudden damage or suffering; a disaster. While a pandemic can be catastrophic, the term does not specifically denote a widespread disease. In Hindi, "Catastrophic" is "विनाशकारी" (Vinaashkaari).
